text:
miriam.ops: Heads-up — helm upgrade for release `gpupool-eu` in eu-west-2 failed during preflight. Preinstall hook job `gpupool-preflight` is Pending and never schedules. PVCs stuck in Terminating for the hook pod.
raj_infra: @miriam.ops can you paste the pod events? sounds like zone affinity or pvc topology mismatch.
miriam.ops: Pod events: 
```
Events:
  Type     Reason            Age                  From               Message
  ----     ------            ----                 ----               -------
  Normal   Scheduled         2m (x2 over 3m)      default-scheduler  0/6 nodes are available: 4 node(s) didn't match node selector, 2 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
  Warning  FailedScheduling  30s (x10 over 3m)    default-scheduler  0/6 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 4 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate.
```

raj_infra: hmm gpu shortage + taint issue. Which taints?
sre-jordan: Looking at node labels/taints — we have new `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` taint applied after last autoscaler job. Hook pod doesn't tolerate it. That's the rollout automation applying nodepool-level taints to reserve GPUs for Dedicated customers.
miriam.ops: That explains it. The preinstall job doesn't set tolerations because chart assumes generic nodes. The release is blocked; gitops is waiting on helm hook to complete so the whole upgrade can't progress.
daria-platform: Can we add tolerations to the hook via values override for this release? quick patch would be `hook.tolerations: - key: "dedicated" operator: "Equal" value: "gpu" effect: "NoSchedule"`
raj_infra: We could, but there's also PVC topology: the hook claims PVC in zone eu-west-2b but most GPU nodes are in eu-west-2a. The job requests 1Gi and storageclass is zonal. So even with toleration it may not schedule in the other zone.
miriam.ops: Oof — zone imbalance. Is this from the recent tf change to nodepool distribution?
raj_infra: Yes — Terraform autoscaling pools were consolidated and we reduced capacity in 2b to cut costs. That left few GPU nodes in 2b. Cost saving caused this drift.
daria-platform: Two options: 1) patch helm chart to run preflight as non-gpu job (run on control-plane taint-tolerant node) or 2) temporarily restore GPU capacity in 2b. Which is faster?
sre-jordan: Temp restore is fastest if we have spare capacity; we can scale up a small gpu pool in 2b. But that costs $$$ and takes ~12min to provision. Patch could be done in ~15-30m with safer cost.
miriam.ops: For customer-facing release we prefer not to pay extra. I'd rather patch the hook to add tolerations and make storage class multi-zone. Can we do a quick Helm values override: `values: { preflight: { tolerations: [...], nodeSelector: { kubernetes.io/os: linux }, storageClass: "gpuzonal-multi" } }`
raj_infra: I'm worried about side effects — preflight checks rely on GPUs to validate scheduling behavior. If we run on non-gpu nodes we may miss real regressions.
daria-platform: True. Another option: add a `--skip-preflight` flag in the chart for canary rollouts so gitops can proceed while we fix infra, and then run preflight offline. Less risky to unblock.
sre-jordan: I can change the release process to allow canary with skip-preflight for non-critical releases. For this one, is it critical?
miriam.ops: This is the platform runtime minor bump that includes perf kernels — we prefer full preflight. But emergency hotfix can go with skip and a post-deployment gated preflight job run manually.
raj_infra: Given time, I'd recommend: 1) revert the Terraform nodepool consolidation for 2b (scale +1 gpu node) to unblock in ~12m, 2) follow up with chart authors to make hook tolerations/configurable, 3) add a guard in our rollout automation to detect zonal GPU shortages and fall back to canary+manual preflight.
daria-platform: I'll open a quick PR to chart repo for configurable tolerations + storageClass. @deploy-bot can you create an incident ticket for the drift and assign to infra and platform? :slightly_smiling_face:
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-4682 — "GPU zone imbalance blocking helm preinstall hook — gpupool-eu" assigned to raj_infra, daria-platform, mreops-team.
miriam.ops: Thanks. I'll hold the release for now. If infra can scale 2b in the next 15m we can retry; otherwise we'll cut a canary with skip-preflight.
raj_infra: Starting scale-up now. pushing Terraform apply (plan approved). ETA ~13m. Will report back in this thread.
sre-jordan: Also adding a check in rollout automation to detect pending hook pods stuck >5m and auto-notify oncall + suggest skip-preflight flag.
miriam.ops: Perfect. keep me posted. :thumbsup:
raj_infra: Terraform apply completed, nodepool in 2b scaled to 1 GPU node. Hook pod scheduled and Completed. Helm upgrade resumed and succeeded.
miriam.ops: Release succeeded. Follow-ups: daria-platform to PR chart tolerations + multi-zone SC, raj_infra to revert cost-optimization change with a safer schedule, sre-jordan to add rollout automation check.
daria-platform: PR created: github.com/redwood/chart-gpupool/pull/212 — adds preflight.tolerations and preflight.storageClass with sane defaults.
raj_infra: I'll start a postmortem doc and cost-impact analysis for the temporary scale (added to INC-4682).
miriam.ops: Great work everyone. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
